0022600094.text: The Atlanta Hawks (1-0, first in the Southeast and second in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (1-0, third in the Southeast and sixth in the East) in the second game of the 2026-27 season for both teams, and both are unbeaten so far. The teams have not met yet this season, and in the 2025-26 season series the Hawks lost 1-3, including a 110-107 loss in Charlotte on February 11, 2026. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery).
